_about: Accessible paths that are missing from Dartmouth's Path of Travel AND from OpenStreetMap, added by hand. Every feature must be checked on satellite imagery; say who checked it and how in 'note'. scripts/build_graph.py adds these to the network (source 'added'). Material: Concrete, Pavement, Brick, Gravel or Crosswalk.

properties.note: South sidewalk of E Wheelock St (Route 10), from the Main St crosswalk east to the Hopkins Center plaza. Wide paved sidewalk visible on Esri satellite imagery; reported by Aditya from the app (Oct 30). Checked on imagery.
